title: Overriding and delegating
hints: Service embeds *Logger, so it gets Logger's Log method for free. Declaring a Log method on *Service itself shadows the promoted one.
Inside Service.Log, calling s.Log would call Service.Log again, forever. Reach the embedded logger explicitly through its field name, s.Logger.
func (s *Service) Log(msg string) { s.Logger.Log("[" + s.Name + "] " + msg) }
